gen.title: Check recent carbon dioxide records and drivers

cards.stem: What was the global average atmospheric carbon dioxide level reported for 2024?
cards.quote: global average atmospheric carbon dioxide was 422.8 parts per million (“ppm,” for short) in 2024, a new record high
cards.hint: Recall the new record high noted for the most recent year.

cards.stem: What is the main cause of the current rise in atmospheric carbon dioxide concentrations?
cards.quote: Carbon dioxide concentrations are rising mostly because of the fossil fuels that people have been burning for energy
cards.hint: Think about what human energy use releases.

cards.stem: How fast did atmospheric carbon dioxide increase on average in the 1960s?
cards.quote: In the 1960s, atmospheric carbon dioxide increased by about 0.8 ppm per year on average
cards.hint: Look at the earliest decade of continuous measurements.

cards.stem: What is the term for the drop in ocean pH that harms marine shell formation?
cards.quote: This drop in pH is called ocean acidification, and it interferes with the ability of marine life
cards.hint: Recall the effect of added carbon dioxide on seawater chemistry.

exactly one option per card matches the quote (one-correct)
every number in stems, options and hints appears on the cited page or in the same quote as that whole signed number (N-01) (numbers-checkable)
no distractor occurs in its card quote (distractors-not-in-quote)
